name: shipcheck
description: Security check for people who ship fast. Point any AI at your server and your code and get back a plain-English report plus a fix brief it can work straight through. Checks internet exposure (including IPv6), firewall, SSH, Docker, patching and backups on the server; and in your code: leaked keys, committed .env, missing rate limiting on login, unvalidated file uploads, unprotected routes, SQL injection, open Firebase rules and secrets shipped to the browser. Read-only. Ships tested fix recipes.
